# LocalCloud

> Contract-generated LocalCloud context. Reviewed 2026-08-13; runtime aabbf62b5e72ddd6d29357c36c813bcae8928912; CLI 9045e94e4603d9909f780d6e0b57a93b2f947304.

LocalCloud provides 25 available services and 1 coming-soon service guide. Google Sheets is an integration surface rather than a LocalCloud service. It is not a production replacement. Use is governed by the proprietary LocalCloud license; review the license before use. The proprietary license permits limited non-commercial personal use by an Individual Developer acting personally; the license text governs. Excluded uses include employer or organization use, commercial development, cost-saving internal tools, team CI, shared team workflows.

## Quick start

```bash
curl -fsSL https://local.cloud/install.sh | sh
localcloud doctor
localcloud start
eval "$(localcloud env)"
localcloud console
```

## Runtime facts

- Default project: `local-gcp-project`
- Default user: `local-developer`
- Default instance: `default`
- CLI memory default: `4g`
- Health endpoint: `http://localhost:24080/health`
- Shell environment endpoint: `http://localhost:24080/env?format=shell`
- Terraform environment endpoint: `http://localhost:24080/env?format=terraform`

Trust URLs and endpoint values returned by the selected CLI instance; occupied canonical ports may be remapped. LocalCloud emulates bounded local development workflows. Validate application behavior against real Google Cloud before production deployment.

## Safety boundaries

- The mutable image identity is release-unverified; prefer the host CLI and pin a qualified digest for release work.
- Default CLI Docker-socket and transparent-network settings are off.
- Technical tiers and successful startup do not grant legal permission.
- Runtime telemetry and other outbound behaviors are documented at https://local.cloud/docs/privacy/.
- Validate allowed release behavior against real Google Cloud after clearing local endpoint variables.
